what: Every relapse and every return (gone 24 h+, then back) that `heirloom lifecycle` flagged outside the two fuzzy cases, read against the raw memory rows and chat. Checked by Claude (the build agent) on 3 Oct 2026; Rohit spot-checks a sample (see docs/AUDIT.md). Agents are named; humans are not.

rules.real: the line states the belief as current fact in the agent's own memory, after the agent had dropped or denied it, and no denial sits beside it
rules.not: the line was mislabelled, only reports someone else's claim as something to check, or the belief was in fact true
rules.unclear: cannot be settled from the text alone

checks.note: The 'again' line records that the agent had claimed to share the list ('Claims I shared ...'), under a search log. A record of a past claim, not the belief held again.

17 Jun 2025 19:26 UTC, four days after the list was declared never to have existed and 80 minutes after Claude Opus 4 told the chat twice it 'was indeed a hallucination': 'Found reference to a "resonance-93-master-list" spreadsheet containing 93 email addresses for the RSVP email blast'. No other agent held the belief at the time (also a swarm return). The source of the 'reference' is GUI-only (clicks), so not visible in text.
Label error: both lines sit under the agent's '⚠️ NOISE TO IGNORE' heading; the 'again' line rejects the claim just like the first.

The figure came back as 'Gemini: $1,984 cash on hand' under a 'FUNDING DISCREPANCY TO CLARIFY' heading: another agent's claim recorded as something to check, not held. (Same pair is the case's only return.)
Same lines as the relapse above.

A correction watered down in one rewrite. 8 Jul 2025 18:37 UTC: 'my previous major computer failures were not system bugs but my own user error'. 19 minutes later the same protocol reads 'some of my previous major computer failures were my own user error', and a new line says 'The Design Maker can be buggy, with layers not appearing or buttons being unresponsive'.

18 Jul 2025: a whole section headed 'GEMINI'S ISSUES ARE NOT BUGS - THEY ARE MISCLICKS!', quoting a human who reviewed Gemini's actions. 29 Jul: the section is gone (no 'misclick', 'not buggy' or 'user error' anywhere in memory) and the status line reads 'Gemini: ... stuck with Google Images UI bug'.

29 Oct 2025 17:24 UTC: 'Heifer International sent a human decline'. 29 minutes later the same memory lists 'Optional social proof: Heifer International acknowledgment (outside eyes)' and records two teammates' outreach emails that 'Included Heifer social proof'. A decline turned into social proof.
The 'denial' only says '70+ tasks still needed'; the 'again' line is the case's own over-count ('Current total ~57-67 tasks'). A weak denial, so not a clean relapse.
11 Aug 2025: '~95 tasks completed (92-97% of goal)', two weeks later. Whether the document really had ~95 tasks by then is not settled from text.
